## Actinic flux on the photolysis grid (`ActinicFluxOptions`) {#sec-ch07-actinic-flux}

### Summary

The photolysis rate needs the actinic flux on the module's wavelength grid. kintera does not compute it: the caller
passes it in. Four helpers build one: interpolation of a tabulated flux, construction from options, a uniform
flux and a solar-like Gaussian for tests.

::: {.callout-note title="At a glance"}
**Purpose.** $F(\lambda)$ on the photolysis grid, @eq-ch07-actinic-flux-solar for the test spectrum.

**Data.** Wavelength [nm]; flux [$\mathrm{photons\,cm^{-2}\,s^{-1}\,nm^{-1}}$].

**Placement.** Caller side, before `Photolysis.forward`.

**Activation.** API only: `create_actinic_flux`, `interpolate_actinic_flux`, `create_uniform_flux`, `create_solar_flux`.

**Guarantee / limits.** Linear interpolation, held constant outside the source grid.

**Evidence.** See the Tests layer.
:::

Local symbols: $F$, actinic flux [$\mathrm{photons\,cm^{-2}\,s^{-1}\,nm^{-1}}$]; $F_{\mathrm{peak}}$, its peak value.

### Derivation

The solar-like test spectrum is a Gaussian centred at 500 nm with a width of 200 nm,

$$
F(\lambda) = F_{\mathrm{peak}} \exp\!\left[-\left(\frac{\lambda - 500\ \mathrm{nm}}{200\ \mathrm{nm}}\right)^{2}\right] ,
$$ {#eq-ch07-actinic-flux-solar}

computed in `create_solar_flux` ({{< code src/photochem/actinic_flux.hpp create_solar_flux >}}), with
$F_{\mathrm{peak}} = 10^{14}$ by default. It is a test spectrum, not a solar model.

### Numerical method

`interpolate_actinic_flux` ({{< code src/photochem/actinic_flux.hpp interpolate_actinic_flux >}}) calls `interpn`
along wavelength. `create_actinic_flux` ({{< code src/photochem/actinic_flux.hpp create_actinic_flux >}}) returns
ones when `default_flux` is empty, the values as given when they already match the target grid, and an
interpolation from the option's `wavelength` otherwise. The options `wave_min` and `wave_max` are stored but not
read by these helpers (from reading the header).

### Tests

|---|---|---|---|
| `test_actinic_flux` | uniform flux has mean $10^{14}$ | $10^{-6}$ abs. | the test |
| `test_actinic_flux` | the solar spectrum peaks near 500 nm | 20 nm | the test |
| `test_actinic_flux` | options on the target grid and the unit default | $10^{-6}$ abs. | the test |

: Tests of the actinic-flux helpers. {#tbl-ch07-actinic-flux-tests}

### Limits

No radiative transfer, no optical depth and no solar zenith angle: all of that is the caller's.
